updates.title: Market Update
updates.content: The S&P 500 index continued its upward trend this week, attempting to break to a new high, despite low volume indicating a lack of conviction.

updates.title: Current Developments
updates.content: The release of PCE data came as expected, with headline PCE at 0.0% and core PCE at 0.1%, while personal spending dropped 0.1% below consensus.

updates.title: Market Reactions
updates.content: The oil price index USO rose to a 3-month high, driven by seasonal demand and supply disruptions, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 8.9% in the first half of 2026.

updates.title: Portfolio Strategy
updates.content: A diversified long-term investor may consider holding onto mega-cap stocks and fossil fuel energy stocks, while remaining cautious and waiting for the air to clear post the presidential debate.

updates.title: Looking Ahead
updates.content: Next week's market will be influenced by the presidential debate's outcome and potential changes in the portfolios, as well as the impact of hurricane season on oil supply.
